unit: GB = 1000000000 bytes; GiB logs converted before rounding
metric: Approximate model weight capacity excluding SSD PLE/ngram lookup table. Not total runtime RAM or minimum installed RAM.
excluded_runtime_memory: OS page cache of the disk-backed ngram table
tp2_policy: whole target model, not per node; rank replication and runtime overhead require additional memory

strata.precision: approximate from rounded engine loading log
strata.basis: Strata native loaded39.97GiB, same IQ3_XXS pack for all3PC rows; excluding separate PLE table

halogen.precision: approximate from rounded measured engine loading log
halogen.basis: Halogen68.0GiB weights locked inRAM including quality overlay, separate47.7GiB lookup table not held inRAM

mlx.precision: exact safetensors payload summed, display rounded
mlx.basis: fixed snapshot safetensors tensors excluding ngram scale, separate ngram_table.bin excluded; includes tensors in checkpoint even if no-vision omits loading them

vllm.precision: exact safetensors payload summed, display rounded
vllm.basis: 70 safetensors in fixed source snapshot, separate ple-table shards excluded; full target checkpoint size, TP2 is whole model rather than per rank
